title: Durable, inspectable and correctable personal and company memory
whatBuilt: DURABLE: per-scope append-only HASH-CHAINED log (each entry digests the previous chain digest); verify_chain re-verifies the whole chain — long-gap recovery proven identical and tampering detected (brokenAtSeq)
INSPECTABLE: owner-only full audit trail with provenance (source, capturedAt, seq, kind)

CORRECTABLE: corrections APPEND bound to the original (never rewrite); the effective retrieval view surfaces the corrected text with the original's tags; original stays inspectable; superseded entries excluded
DISABLE / FORGET: disable excludes from retrieval but stays inspectable; forget is a crypto-delete (content dropped, tombstone keeps the chain intact)
PERSONAL/COMPANY SEPARATION: company scope demands the company role; cross-scope writes/reads denied; canonical project/assessment records untouched (no mutation API exists — contract-proven)
RETRIEVAL: relevance = explicit tags ∩ query tags ranked deterministically by (matches, freshness, seq); freshness (ageDays) reported; stale entries flagged

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 177/177 pass (165 previous + 12 memory)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The memory module is the CONTRACT plane; the real durable store (SQL/object) and retrieval-adapter integration remain hosted/integration work. No mastery or educational-gain claim is made. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
